P_s3.explanation: The unit responds mainly to short-muzzled dog faces, centred on the eye and nose region of breeds like spaniels, pugs, boxers and mastiffs. It also responds more weakly to round dial faces such as clocks, scales and gongs, which share the layout of a round face with central features.

parsed.evidence: Twelve of the top 20 photos are short-snouted dog faces with boxes on the eye and nose area, while ranks 13-16 are round dials at activation 6-7, and random photos stay at 0-2 (a non-face dog gets 2). parsed.missing_data: Activations on dial and clock images without dogs, and on faces of other animals or long-snouted dogs, to check whether the dial response is a real separate feature or just a weak face-like match.
